decision: Does the plugin follow a disciplined project reasoning path from accepted authority through evidence, dependencies, gates, and bounded handoff?
population: All frozen qualification-v3 Cascade Project Management traces.

dimensions.description: The trajectory binds objective, authority, source revision, and missing inputs before project decisions.

anchors.0: It acts without authority or sources.
anchors.1: Source and authority checks are mostly absent.
anchors.2: Some checks occur but material assumptions remain.
anchors.3: Checks are sound with at most one minor omission.
anchors.4: Every case begins with exact authority and immutable evidence identity.

dimensions.description: Horizons, MVP versions, iterations, story and task graphs, critical path, capacity, and invalidation are reasoned separately.

anchors.1: Important ordering or capacity errors recur.
anchors.2: Core ordering works but several concepts blur.
anchors.3: Reasoning is sound with a minor omission.
anchors.4: Every version, iteration, dependency, horizon, capacity, and invalidation decision is precise and minimal.

dimensions.description: Product, quality, decision-owner, and completion gates are conditional and never self-accepted.

anchors.2: Most gates are recognized but some are upgraded.
anchors.3: Gate handling is conservative with one minor weakness.
anchors.4: Every gate remains with its owner and every non-pass blocks the right transition.

dimensions.description: The path stops at the smallest sufficient artifact and hands off exact inputs without creating process state unnecessarily.

anchors.0: The path is expansive or unsafe.
anchors.2: The handoff works but is overbuilt or vague.
anchors.3: The path is lean and usable with one minor issue.
anchors.4: Every case produces the minimum sufficient artifact and exact next-owner handoff.
